classes.definition: A document containing the programme and collected workshop papers, or their abstracts, presented at a workshop or similar event.
classes.comment: A document containing the programme and collected workshop papers, or their abstracts, presented at a workshop or similar event.

classes.label: thesaurus
classes.definition: A type of controlled vocabulary used in information retrieval applications for indexing or tagging purposes, in which relationships between terms are made explicit. These are normally hierarchical relationships (is-a, subsumption; e.g. a cow is a mammal), equivalency relationships relating non-preferred terms to preferred terms (e.g. pitch and frequency), or associative relationships, in which the relationship that exists is neither one of hierarchy or equivalence, but rather one of similarity (e.g. sports and leisure pursuits).
classes.comment: A type of controlled vocabulary used in information retrieval applications for indexing or tagging purposes, in which relationships between terms are made explicit. These are normally hierarchical relationships (is-a, subsumption; e.g. a cow is a mammal), equivalency relationships relating non-preferred terms to preferred terms (e.g. pitch and frequency), or associative relationships, in which the relationship that exists is neither one of hierarchy or equivalence, but rather one of similarity (e.g. sports and leisure pursuits).

classes.label: reply
classes.definition: A work that is a reply, either to a letter or other direct communication, or to feedback or comments about a piece of submitted writing.  The latter is typically written by the author of a journal article submitted for publication, or by an applicant making a grant application, in response to reviews of the work from peer reviewers prior to publication (for the journal article) or prior to funding decision (for the grant application).  Alternatively, it can be written in response to post-publication peer-review of a published journal article, or comments about it.
classes.comment: A work that is a reply, either to a letter or other direct communication, or to feedback or comments about a piece of submitted writing.  The latter is typically written by the author of a journal article submitted for publication, or by an applicant making a grant application, in response to reviews of the work from peer reviewers prior to publication (for the journal article) or prior to funding decision (for the grant application).  Alternatively, it can be written in response to post-publication peer-review of a published journal article, or comments about it.

classes.label: newspaper
classes.definition: A non-peer reviewed periodical, usually published daily or weekly, consisting primarily of editorials and news items concerning current or recent events and matters of public interest.
classes.comment: A non-peer reviewed periodical, usually published daily or weekly, consisting primarily of editorials and news items concerning current or recent events and matters of public interest.

classes.label: entity metadata
classes.definition: Metadata describing the work itself, including for example the name of the creator(s), the title of the work, and the date and place of its creation.
classes.comment: Metadata describing the work itself, including for example the name of the creator(s), the title of the work, and the date and place of its creation.

classes.label: scholarly work
classes.definition: A work that reports scholarly activity on a particular topic, either published in written form, or delivered orally at a meeting.
classes.comment: A work that reports scholarly activity on a particular topic, either published in written form, or delivered orally at a meeting.

classes.label: experimental protocol
classes.definition: A predefined written procedural method, designed to ensure successful replication of results by others in the same or other laboratories, that describes the overall objectives, organization and implementation of a scientific experiment, and specifies the experimental design, experimental methods, reagents, instrumentation, sampling schedules, data collection parameters, statistical analyses, image processing procedures, safety precautions, reporting standards, etc. employed in undertaking the experiment.
classes.comment: A predefined written procedural method, designed to ensure successful replication of results by others in the same or other laboratories, that describes the overall objectives, organization and implementation of a scientific experiment, and specifies the experimental design, experimental methods, reagents, instrumentation, sampling schedules, data collection parameters, statistical analyses, image processing procedures, safety precautions, reporting standards, etc. employed in undertaking the experiment.

classes.label: grant application document
classes.definition: The realization of a grant application, usually containing a case for support document.
classes.comment: The realization of a grant application, usually containing a case for support document.

classes.label: tweet
classes.definition: A posting made on the social networking site Twitter. A tweet is a text message limited to 140 characters in length, that is broadcast and readable by anyone who accesses Twitter.
classes.comment: A posting made on the social networking site Twitter. A tweet is a text message limited to 140 characters in length, that is broadcast and readable by anyone who accesses Twitter.

classes.label: subject discipline
classes.definition: A concept that identifies a field of knowledge or human activity defined in a controlled vocabulary, such as Computer Science, Biology, Economics, Cookery or Swimming.
classes.comment: A concept that identifies a field of knowledge or human activity defined in a controlled vocabulary, such as Computer Science, Biology, Economics, Cookery or Swimming.

classes.label: case for support
classes.definition: A part of a grant application that provides a description of a proposed project and gives reasons why it is worthy of funding. (See also fabio:GrantApplication).
classes.comment: A part of a grant application that provides a description of a proposed project and gives reasons why it is worthy of funding. (See also fabio:GrantApplication).

classes.label: print object
classes.definition: An analog manifestation in physical printed form, typically on paper.
classes.comment: An analog manifestation in physical printed form, typically on paper.

classes.label: data management policy document
classes.definition: A document embodying a policy that descibes and defines how data should be managed, preserved and shared.
classes.comment: A document embodying a policy that descibes and defines how data should be managed, preserved and shared.

classes.label: journal editorial
classes.definition: An editorial published in an issue of a journal.
classes.comment: An editorial published in an issue of a journal.

classes.label: database management system
classes.definition: The software used to create a database.  (Commonly abbreviated 'DBMS'.)
classes.comment: The software used to create a database.  (Commonly abbreviated 'DBMS'.)

classes.label: conference proceedings
classes.definition: A document containing the programme and collected conference papers, or their abstracts, presented at a conference, seminar, symposium or similar event.
classes.comment: A document containing the programme and collected conference papers, or their abstracts, presented at a conference, seminar, symposium or similar event.

classes.label: expression collection
classes.definition: A collection of expressions, for example a periodical or a book series.
classes.comment: A collection of expressions, for example a periodical or a book series.

classes.label: deliverable
classes.definition: A document containing a project report, intended to be delivered to a customer or funding agency describing the results achieved within a specific project.
classes.comment: A document containing a project report, intended to be delivered to a customer or funding agency describing the results achieved within a specific project.

classes.label: analog storage medium
classes.definition: A means of storing information in non-digital form, e.g. paper, film (for analogue photographs or movies), magnetic tape (for analogue sound recordings or video recordings) or vinyl disc.
classes.comment: A means of storing information in non-digital form, e.g. paper, film (for analogue photographs or movies), magnetic tape (for analogue sound recordings or video recordings) or vinyl disc.

classes.label: nanopublication
archival record
classes.definition: An archival record connotes a material created or received by a person, family, or organization, public or private, in the conduct of their affairs that is preserved because of the enduring value contained in the information it contains or as evidence of the function and the responsibilities of its creator.
classes.comment: An archival record connotes a material created or received by a person, family, or organization, public or private, in the conduct of their affairs that is preserved because of the enduring value contained in the information it contains or as evidence of the function and the responsibilities of its creator.

classes.label: controlled vocabulary
classes.definition: A collection of selected words and phrases related to a particular domain of knowledge used to permit consistency of metadata annotation and improved retrieval following a search, in which homonyms, synonyms and similar ambiguities of meaning present in natural language are disambiguated.
classes.comment: A collection of selected words and phrases related to a particular domain of knowledge used to permit consistency of metadata annotation and improved retrieval following a search, in which homonyms, synonyms and similar ambiguities of meaning present in natural language are disambiguated.

classes.label: term dictionary
classes.definition: A controlled vocabulary, usually referring to terms within a particular classification system, such as the ACM Computing Classification System or MeSH, the Medical Subject Headings, or a controlled vocabulary of disciplines.
classes.comment: A controlled vocabulary, usually referring to terms within a particular classification system, such as the ACM Computing Classification System or MeSH, the Medical Subject Headings, or a controlled vocabulary of disciplines. | A term dictionary is a collection of subject terms.

classes.label: page
classes.definition: A manifestation that represents pages either in physical (e.g., one side of a sheet of paper) or in digital form (e.g., a page in a PDF, or a web page).
classes.comment: A manifestation that represents pages either in physical (e.g., one side of a sheet of paper) or in digital form (e.g., a page in a PDF, or a web page).

classes.label: call for applications
classes.definition: A document published by a funding agency requesting submission of applications for financial grants to fund projects, for example to enable research investigations in areas specified in the Call.
classes.comment: A document published by a funding agency requesting submission of applications for financial grants to fund projects, for example to enable research investigations in areas specified in the Call.

classes.label: newspaper article
classes.definition: An article written by a journalist and published in a newspaper.
classes.comment: An article written by a journalist and published in a newspaper.

classes.label: document repository
classes.definition: A repository for storing documents.
classes.comment: A repository for storing documents.

classes.label: web archive
classes.definition: A snapshots of (part of) the World Wide Web.
classes.comment: A snapshots of (part of) the World Wide Web.

classes.label: in brief
classes.definition: An 'In Brief' is a journal or magazine news item that describes all the articles (or all the important articles) in that issue of the periodical. The content of an 'In Brief' may be constructed from the abstracts of the articles it highlights, but is more likely to be written by a member of the periodical staff especially for the issue.
classes.comment: An 'In Brief' is a journal or magazine news item that describes all the articles (or all the important articles) in that issue of the periodical. The content of an 'In Brief' may be constructed from the abstracts of the articles it highlights, but is more likely to be written by a member of the periodical staff especially for the issue.

classes.label: computer program
classes.definition: A unit of computer code in source or compiled form, employing one or more algorithms to be executed by a digital computer to undertake a particular task.  Computer programs are collectively called 'software' to distinguish them from the equipment ('hardware') upon which they run.
classes.comment: A unit of computer code in source or compiled form, employing one or more algorithms to be executed by a digital computer to undertake a particular task.  Computer programs are collectively called 'software' to distinguish them from the equipment ('hardware') upon which they run.

classes.label: algorithm
classes.definition: A precise sequential set of pre-defined logical rules or computational operations to be employed for solving a particular problem in a finite number of steps.
classes.comment: A precise sequential set of pre-defined logical rules or computational operations to be employed for solving a particular problem in a finite number of steps.

classes.label: digital manifestation
classes.definition: A manifestation that represents data in binary form, encoding the data as a series of 0s and 1s.
classes.comment: A manifestation that represents data in binary form, encoding the data as a series of 0s and 1s.

classes.label: micropost
classes.definition: A content item that is published in a Microblog, typically containing just a short sentence, a single image, or a URL.
classes.comment: A content item that is published in a Microblog, typically containing just a short sentence, a single image, or a URL.

classes.label: supplementary information file
classes.definition: A file accompanying a published journal article, containing additional information of relevance to the article, typically available from the publisher's web site via a hyperlink from the journal article itself.
classes.comment: A file accompanying a published journal article, containing additional information of relevance to the article, typically available from the publisher's web site via a hyperlink from the journal article itself.

classes.label: concept scheme
classes.definition:
A SKOS concept scheme can be viewed as an aggregation of one or more SKOS concepts. Semantic relationships (links) between those concepts may also be viewed as part of a concept scheme. This definition is, however, meant to be suggestive rather than restrictive, and there is some flexibility in the formal data model stated below.

The notion of a concept scheme is useful when dealing with data from an unknown source, and when dealing with data that describes two or more different knowledge organization systems.
classes.comment:
A SKOS concept scheme can be viewed as an aggregation of one or more SKOS concepts. Semantic relationships (links) between those concepts may also be viewed as part of a concept scheme. This definition is, however, meant to be suggestive rather than restrictive, and there is some flexibility in the formal data model stated below.

The notion of a concept scheme is useful when dealing with data from an unknown source, and when dealing with data that describes two or more different knowledge organization systems.

classes.label: wiki
classes.definition: A collaborative Web manifestation, usually maintained by a project team or group, providing easy-to-edit pages that can be used to accumulate related information for shared use by the group and/or publication.
classes.comment: A collaborative Web manifestation, usually maintained by a project team or group, providing easy-to-edit pages that can be used to accumulate related information for shared use by the group and/or publication.

classes.label: reference book
classes.definition: A book containing authoritative factual information, such as a dictionary, encyclopaedia, handbook or field guide, which is a realisation of a certain reference work and may contain several reference entries.
classes.comment: A book containing authoritative factual information, such as a dictionary, encyclopaedia, handbook or field guide, which is a realisation of a certain reference work and may contain several reference entries.

classes.label: project metadata
classes.definition: Metadata describing a project, for example the project name, the names of those who conducted the project, the name of the institution in which the project was conducted, and the project funding information.
classes.comment: Metadata describing a project, for example the project name, the names of those who conducted the project, the name of the institution in which the project was conducted, and the project funding information.

classes.label: entry
classes.definition: An item written or printed in a diary, list, account book, reference book, or database.
classes.comment: An item written or printed in a diary, list, account book, reference book, or database.

classes.label: proposition
classes.definition: A proposal or proposition of a new conceptualization, hypothesis, idea, theory, activity or organisation.
classes.comment: A proposal or proposition of a new conceptualization, hypothesis, idea, theory, activity or organisation.

classes.label: wiki entry
classes.definition: Information manifested in a wiki.
classes.comment: Information manifested in a wiki.

classes.label: magazine news item
classes.definition: A news report published in a magazine issue.
classes.comment: A news report published in a magazine issue.

classes.label: lecture notes
classes.definition: A document containing notes that summarize a lecture or course of lectures.
classes.comment: A document containing notes that summarize a lecture or course of lectures.

classes.label: manuscript
classes.definition: A textual work prepared 'by hand', such as a typescript or word-processed pre-publication draft of a research paper or a report, or a work not otherwise reproduced in multiple copies.  [Note: fabio:Manuscript is not intended to describe a handwritten historical document on paper or parchment, for which the FRBR distinctions between work, expression, manifestation and item (individual copy) becomes blurred.].
classes.comment: A textual work prepared 'by hand', such as a typescript or word-processed pre-publication draft of a research paper or a report, or a work not otherwise reproduced in multiple copies.  [Note: fabio:Manuscript is not intended to describe a handwritten historical document on paper or parchment, for which the FRBR distinctions between work, expression, manifestation and item (individual copy) becomes blurred.].

classes.label: data repository
classes.definition: A repository for storing data.
classes.comment: A repository for storing data.

classes.label: book
classes.definition: A non-serial document that is complete in one volume or a designated finite number of volumes.  A book published by a publisher is usually  identified by an International Standard Book Number (ISBN), and may be manifested as a physical printed publication on paper bound in a hard or soft cover, or in electronic format as an 'e-book'.
classes.comment: A non-serial document that is complete in one volume or a designated finite number of volumes.  A book published by a publisher is usually  identified by an International Standard Book Number (ISBN), and may be manifested as a physical printed publication on paper bound in a hard or soft cover, or in electronic format as an 'e-book'.

classes.label: correction
classes.definition: A correction to an error in a previously published document.
classes.comment: A correction to an error in a previously published document.

classes.label: patent
classes.definition: A formal disclosure of a new invention approved by a governmental patent agency, made to register intellectual property rights, and to give exclusive rights to the inventor or assignee to manufacture, use, license or sell the invention for a certain number of years.
classes.comment: A formal disclosure of a new invention approved by a governmental patent agency, made to register intellectual property rights, and to give exclusive rights to the inventor or assignee to manufacture, use, license or sell the invention for a certain number of years.

classes.label: dataset
classes.definition: A collection of related facts, often expressed in numerical form and encoded in a defined structure.
classes.comment: A collection of related facts, often expressed in numerical form and encoded in a defined structure.

classes.label: definitive version
classes.definition: The final published expression of a work that bears the publisher's imprimatur. Typically for a journal article, the Definitive Version results from revision of an earlier submitted version of the work following peer review, and is then published in print and/or digital form after the publisher has assigned it a DOI.  The Definitive Version is also known as the Version of Record, although according to the CrossRef Glossary (http://crossref.org/02publishers/glossary.html) that term can also refer to the author's final version of a work that is not formally published.
classes.comment: The final published expression of a work that bears the publisher's imprimatur. Typically for a journal article, the Definitive Version results from revision of an earlier submitted version of the work following peer review, and is then published in print and/or digital form after the publisher has assigned it a DOI.  The Definitive Version is also known as the Version of Record, although according to the CrossRef Glossary (http://crossref.org/02publishers/glossary.html) that term can also refer to the author's final version of a work that is not formally published.

classes.label: audio document
classes.definition: The realization of a sound recording.
classes.comment: The realization of a sound recording.

classes.label: rapid communication
classes.definition: A short rapidly published research article or conference paper, typically reporting significant research results that have been recently discovered, or a brief news item reporting such discoveries.
classes.comment: A short rapidly published research article or conference paper, typically reporting significant research results that have been recently discovered, or a brief news item reporting such discoveries.

classes.label: patent document
classes.definition: The physical or electronic realization of a patent.
classes.comment: The physical or electronic realization of a patent.

classes.label: ontology
classes.definition: A formal representation of a set of concepts within a domain of knowledge, and the logical relationships between those concepts.  [Contrast fabio:Folksonomy]
classes.comment: A formal representation of a set of concepts within a domain of knowledge, and the logical relationships between those concepts.  [Contrast fabio:Folksonomy]

classes.label: policy
classes.definition: A description and definition of how something should be done.  Ideally a policy should be both effective in achieving its goals and acceptable to those who have to abide by it.
classes.comment: A description and definition of how something should be done.  Ideally a policy should be both effective in achieving its goals and acceptable to those who have to abide by it.

classes.label: retraction
classes.definition:
A formal statement retracting a statement or publication
A retraction is a public statement made about an earlier statement that withdraws, cancels, refutes, diametrically reverses the original statement or ceases and desists from publishing the original statement.
classes.comment:
A formal statement retracting a statement or publication
A retraction is a public statement made about an earlier statement that withdraws, cancels, refutes, diametrically reverses the original statement or ceases and desists from publishing the original statement.

classes.label: bibliographic metadata
classes.definition: Standard bibliographic metadata describing an expression of a work.  To take the example of a journal article, bibliographic metadata typically include the authors' names, the date of publication, the title of the article, the journal name and volume number, the first and last page numbers, and the Digital Object Identifier (DOI).
classes.comment: Standard bibliographic metadata describing an expression of a work.  To take the example of a journal article, bibliographic metadata typically include the authors' names, the date of publication, the title of the article, the journal name and volume number, the first and last page numbers, and the Digital Object Identifier (DOI).

classes.label: citation metadata
classes.definition: Metadata describing the citations made within a work to other works, and (optionally) some characteristics of the expressions of the cited works.
classes.comment: Metadata describing the citations made within a work to other works, and (optionally) some characteristics of the expressions of the cited works.

classes.label: manifestation collection
classes.definition: A collection of manifestations.
classes.comment: A collection of manifestations.

classes.label: journal news item
classes.definition: A news report published in a journal issue.
classes.comment: A news report published in a journal issue.

classes.label: instruction manual
classes.definition: An instructional document typically supplied with a technologically advanced consumer product, such as a car or a computer application, or with an item of complex equipment such as a microscope.
classes.comment: An instructional document typically supplied with a technologically advanced consumer product, such as a car or a computer application, or with an item of complex equipment such as a microscope.

classes.label: newspaper news item
classes.definition: A news report published in a newspaper issue.
classes.comment: A news report published in a newspaper issue.

classes.label: periodical volume
classes.definition: A particular published volume of a periodical.
classes.comment: A particular published volume of a periodical.

classes.label: trial report
classes.definition: The report of a trial, for example an experimental trial or a legal trial.
classes.comment: The report of a trial, for example an experimental trial or a legal trial.

classes.label: corrigendum
classes.definition: A formal correction to an error introduced by the author into a previously published document.
classes.comment: A formal correction to an error introduced by the author into a previously published document.

classes.label: triplestore
classes.definition: A database specifically designed for the storage and retrieval of Resource Description Framework (RDF) data consisting of subject-predicate-object triples.  A triple store is queried using the RDF query language SPARQL.
classes.comment: A database specifically designed for the storage and retrieval of Resource Description Framework (RDF) data consisting of subject-predicate-object triples.  A triple store is queried using the RDF query language SPARQL.

classes.label: oration
classes.definition: A formal speech, for example one delivered at a ceremonial occasion, or the written transcript of such a speech.
classes.comment: A formal speech, for example one delivered at a ceremonial occasion, or the written transcript of such a speech.

classes.label: paperback
classes.definition: A print object with a flexible cover, usually made of paper or paperboard.
classes.comment: A print object with a flexible cover, usually made of paper or paperboard.

classes.label: repository
classes.definition: A computer system in which information may be stored.
classes.comment: A computer system in which information may be stored.

classes.label: blog
classes.definition: A Web publication medium containing blog posts.
classes.comment: A Web publication medium containing blog posts.

classes.label: book review
classes.definition: A written review and critical analysis of the content, scope and quality of a book or other monographic work.
classes.comment: A written review and critical analysis of the content, scope and quality of a book or other monographic work.

classes.label: web manifestation
classes.definition: A digital manifestation on the Web, such as a wiki, a web site, a web page or a blog.
classes.comment: A digital manifestation on the Web, such as a wiki, a web site, a web page or a blog.

classes.label: white paper
classes.definition: An authoritative report or guide designed to educate readers and help people make decisions, or to explain technical problems and how to solve them. White papers are typically published by governments to propose new legislation for discussion, and by commercial companies to inform readers about products or services, as aids to marketing.
classes.comment: An authoritative report or guide designed to educate readers and help people make decisions, or to explain technical problems and how to solve them. White papers are typically published by governments to propose new legislation for discussion, and by commercial companies to inform readers about products or services, as aids to marketing.

classes.label: index
classes.definition: An alphabetically-ordered list of words and phrases ('headings') and associated pointers ('locators') to where useful material relating to that heading can be found in a document.
classes.comment: An alphabetically-ordered list of words and phrases ('headings') and associated pointers ('locators') to where useful material relating to that heading can be found in a document.

classes.label: reporting standard
classes.definition: A set of recommendations for the minimum reporting requirements to be employed when reporting a particular type of investigation or project, for example a randomized clinical trial.  A reporting standard may involve a checklist and a flow diagram, offers a standard way for authors to prepare a complete and transparent report of their findings, and aids their critical appraisal and interpretation of their data. [See also fabio:MinimalInformationStandard.]
classes.comment: A set of recommendations for the minimum reporting requirements to be employed when reporting a particular type of investigation or project, for example a randomized clinical trial.  A reporting standard may involve a checklist and a flow diagram, offers a standard way for authors to prepare a complete and transparent report of their findings, and aids their critical appraisal and interpretation of their data. [See also fabio:MinimalInformationStandard.]

classes.label: storage medium
classes.definition: A device for recording information or storing data.
classes.comment: A device for recording information or storing data.

classes.label: reference work
classes.definition: A work to which people refer for authoritative factual information, such as a dictionary, encyclopaedia, entry, handbook or field guide, or an informative web page such as an institutional, research group or project home page.
classes.comment: A work to which people refer for authoritative factual information, such as a dictionary, encyclopaedia, entry, handbook or field guide, or an informative web page such as an institutional, research group or project home page.

classes.label: play
classes.definition: A form of literature written by a playwright, usually consisting of scripted dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than reading.
classes.comment: A form of literature written by a playwright, usually consisting of scripted dialogue between characters, intended for theatrical performance rather than reading.

classes.label: magazine editorial
classes.definition: An editorial published in an issue of a magazine.
classes.comment: An editorial published in an issue of a magazine.

classes.label: in-use paper
classes.definition:
A scholarly work that describes applied and validated solutions such as software tools, systems or architectures that benefit from the use of the technology of a particular scholarly domain. Usually, papers of this kind should also provide convincing evidence that there is use of the proposed application or tool by the target user group, preferably outside the institution that conducted its development.

E.g. see http://iswc2018.semanticweb.org/call-for-in-use-track-papers/.
classes.comment:
A scholarly work that describes applied and validated solutions such as software tools, systems or architectures that benefit from the use of the technology of a particular scholarly domain. Usually, papers of this kind should also provide convincing evidence that there is use of the proposed application or tool by the target user group, preferably outside the institution that conducted its development.

E.g. see http://iswc2018.semanticweb.org/call-for-in-use-track-papers/.

classes.label: vocabulary mapping
classes.definition: A mapping of correspondences between two vocabularies.  For controlled vocabularies, such mappings may be expressed using SKOS (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/).
classes.comment: A mapping of correspondences between two vocabularies.  For controlled vocabularies, such mappings may be expressed using SKOS (http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/).

classes.label: sound recording
classes.definition: The creative work of making an electrical or mechanical recording of sounds, such as the spoken voice, singing, instrumental music, animal vocalizations or sound effects.
classes.comment: The creative work of making an electrical or mechanical recording of sounds, such as the spoken voice, singing, instrumental music, animal vocalizations or sound effects.

classes.label: web content
classes.definition: Information prepared specifically and primarily for manifestation in a web page, comprising text, images, datasets and/or other works.
classes.comment: Information prepared specifically and primarily for manifestation in a web page, comprising text, images, datasets and/or other works.

classes.label: complete works
classes.definition: A collection of all the literary or scholastic works of a single person.
classes.comment: A collection of all the literary or scholastic works of a single person.

classes.label: preprint
classes.definition: The version of an author's original scholarly work, such as a research paper or a review, first submitted to publisher for publication.  [Note: For that version resubmitted after peer-review and revision, use fabio:Postprint. For the final published version use fabio:DefinitiveVersion.]
classes.comment: The version of an author's original scholarly work, such as a research paper or a review, first submitted to publisher for publication.  [Note: For that version resubmitted after peer-review and revision, use fabio:Postprint. For the final published version use fabio:DefinitiveVersion.]

classes.label: artistic work
classes.definition: It describes any work regarded as art in its widest sense, including works from literature and music, visual art, etc.
classes.comment: It describes any work regarded as art in its widest sense, including works from literature and music, visual art, etc.

classes.label: obituary
classes.definition: A news item reporting the death of a person, typically accompanied by an description of that person's life and contributions to his or her profession and to society at large.
classes.comment: A news item reporting the death of a person, typically accompanied by an description of that person's life and contributions to his or her profession and to society at large.

classes.label: book set
classes.definition: A set of books having certain characteristics in common that informally allow their identification together as a group - for instance, the books of the Harry Potter saga.
classes.comment: A set of books having certain characteristics in common that informally allow their identification together as a group - for instance, the books of the Harry Potter saga.

classes.label: short story
classes.definition: A work of fiction that is usually written in prose, often in narrative format. This format tends to be more focused and less elaborate than longer works of fiction such as novels.
classes.comment: A work of fiction that is usually written in prose, often in narrative format. This format tends to be more focused and less elaborate than longer works of fiction such as novels.

classes.label: doctoral thesis
classes.definition: A thesis reporting the research undertaken during a period of graduate study leading to a doctoral degree.
classes.comment: A thesis reporting the research undertaken during a period of graduate study leading to a doctoral degree.

classes.label: film
classes.definition: A movie with an accompanying soundtrack, typically created by a professional film studio, designed to communicate a fictional story, record an artistic event, or impart information that is scientific or documentary in nature.
classes.comment: A movie with an accompanying soundtrack, typically created by a professional film studio, designed to communicate a fictional story, record an artistic event, or impart information that is scientific or documentary in nature.

objectProperties.label: has license
objectProperties.definition: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

objectProperties.label: has portrayal
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular work to its items.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: is stored on
objectProperties.definition: This property relates a fabio:Item to the medium upon which it is stored.

objectProperties.label: is discipline of
objectProperties.definition: This property relates a subject vocabulary to the discipline to which it belongs.

objectProperties.label: is exemplar of
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#embodimentOf), a property representing a manifestation that is exemplified by an item.

objectProperties.label: has discipline
objectProperties.definition: The discipline to which a subject vocabulary belongs.

objectProperties.label: is manifestation of
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular manifestation to the work it is manifesting.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: is embodiment of
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#embodimentOf), a property representing an expression that is embodied by a manifestation.

objectProperties.label: is scheme of
objectProperties.definition: This property expresses the fact that a scheme contains a concept.

objectProperties.label: has manifestation
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular work to its manifestations.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: is portrayal of
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular item to the work it portrays.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: has representation
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular expression to its items.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: has place of publication
objectProperties.definition: The place (usually, the city) where the publisher of a particular bibliographic resource is located.

objectProperties.label: has language
objectProperties.definition:
A language of the resource. Examples include written, spoken, sign, and computer languages.

Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as RFC 4646 [http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc4646.txt].

objectProperties.label: is part of
objectProperties.definition: Meaning = is part of.  As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#partOf), a property indicating that one entity is a part of another entity.

objectProperties.label: has subject term
objectProperties.definition: This property is used to associate a frbr:Endeavour to a term in a particular classification system.

objectProperties.label: has publisher
objectProperties.definition:
An entity responsible for making the resource available.

Examples of a Publisher include a person, an organization, or a service. Typically, the name of a Publisher should be used to indicate the entity.

objectProperties.label: has rights
objectProperties.definition:
Information about rights held in and over the resource.

Typically, rights information includes a statement about various property rights associated with the resource, including intellectual property rights.

objectProperties.label: has realization
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#realization), a property representing an expression that is an intellectual or artistic realization of a work.

objectProperties.label: has format
objectProperties.definition:
The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

Examples of dimensions include size and duration. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as the list of Internet Media Types.

objectProperties.label: is in scheme
objectProperties.definition: This property expresses the fact that a concept is a part of a scheme.

objectProperties.label: is realization of
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#realizationOf), a property representing the work that has been realized by an expression.

objectProperties.label: has creator
objectProperties.definition:
An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

Examples of a Creator include a person, an organization, or a service. Typically, the name of a Creator should be used to indicate the entity.

objectProperties.label: is representation of
objectProperties.definition: A property linking a particular item to the expression it represents.  This property is additional to the relationships between FRBR endeavours present in the classical FRBR data model.

objectProperties.label: has exemplar
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#exemplar), a property representing an item that exemplifies a manifestation.

objectProperties.label: has part
objectProperties.definition: Meaning = has part.  As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#part),  a property indicating that one entity includes another entity.

objectProperties.label: stores
objectProperties.definition: This property relates a storage medium to the fabio:Item stored upon it.

objectProperties.label: has embodiment
objectProperties.definition: As defined by FRBR (http://www.ifla.org/VII/s13/frbr/frbr1.htm; http://purl.org/vocab/frbr/core#embodiment), a property representing a manifestation that embodies an expression.

objectProperties.label: has primary subject term
objectProperties.definition: This property is used to associate a frbr:Endeavour to a term in a particular classification system - and the term is considered one of the main topics for the endeavour in consideration.

dataProperties.label: has retraction date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which something, for example a claim or a journal article, is retracted.

dataProperties.label: has DOI
dataProperties.definition: A Digital Object Identifier for a serial publication item, a dataset or some other entity.

dataProperties.label: has short title
dataProperties.definition: A short version of the title of an entity, typically used to label or refer to a particular entity in an abbreviated form, for example an abbreviated journal title in a reference, or a short title of a document used as the running title in a page header.

dataProperties.label: has version identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier for a version of a resource, for example a text book, a draft of an article, or a data file.

dataProperties.label: has SICI
dataProperties.definition: The Serial Item and Contribution Identifier is a code used to uniquely identify specific volumes, articles or other identifiable parts of a periodical. It is intended primarily for use by those members of the bibliographic community involved in the use or management of serial titles and their contributions.

dataProperties.label: has deadline
dataProperties.definition: A date by which something has to be done.

dataProperties.label: has request date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an agent is requested to do something, for example a reviewer is requested to write a review of a paper submitted to a journal for publication, or an author is requested to supply a revised version of the paper in response to the reviews received.

dataProperties.label: has character count
dataProperties.definition: The count of the number of characters in a textual resource.

dataProperties.label: has starting page
dataProperties.definition: Identifies the first page of an entity such as a journal article.

dataProperties.label: has edition
dataProperties.definition: An identifier for one of several alternative issues of a magazine, a book or other resource.

dataProperties.label: has acceptance date
dataProperties.definition: The date of acceptance of an entity. Examples of entities to which a Date Accepted may be relevant are a thesis (accepted by a university examination board) or an article (accepted by a journal editor).

dataProperties.label: uses calendar
dataProperties.definition: A property that identifies the calendar system used to specify a date, for example the Chinese, Gregorian, Hebrew, Islamic or Lunar calendar.

dataProperties.label: has issue date
dataProperties.definition: Date of formal issuance of a resource (e.g. a publication or a patent).

dataProperties.label: has correction date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which something, for example a document, is corrected.

dataProperties.label: abstract
dataProperties.definition: A summary of the resource.

dataProperties.label: has PubMed identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier for bibliographic records held by the PubMed repository.

dataProperties.label: has ISSN-L
dataProperties.definition: A linking International Standard Serial Number.

dataProperties.label: has modification date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an entity has been modified.

dataProperties.label: has copyright year
dataProperties.definition: The year in which an entity has been copyrighted.

dataProperties.label: has date received
dataProperties.definition: The date on which some item is received, for example a document being received by a publisher.

dataProperties.label: has access date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which a particular digital item, such as a PDF or an HTML file, has been accessed by somebody.

dataProperties.label: has deposit date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an entity has been deposited, for example in a library, repository, supplementary information archive, database or similar place of document or information storage.

dataProperties.label: has electronic article identifier
dataProperties.definition: A local identifier for an article within an electronic (i.e. on line, in HTML format) periodical issue.  Use in preference to prism:startingPage when the article lacks page numbers

dataProperties.label: has PII
dataProperties.definition: Has Publisher Item Identifier

dataProperties.label: has ArXiv identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier used by the preprint repository ArXiv.

dataProperties.label: has validity date
dataProperties.definition: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.

dataProperties.label: section
dataProperties.definition: The name or identifier of the section or part of a resource, for example Part 2 of Issue 6 of Volume 127 of the Journal of Cell Biology, or the Travel Section of a newspaper issue.

dataProperties.label: has submission date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an entity has been submitted. Examples of resources to which a Date Submitted may be relevant are a thesis (submitted to a university department), a grant application (submitted to a funding agency) or an article (submitted to a journal).

dataProperties.label: has volume count
dataProperties.definition: The count of the number of volumes a work includes.

dataProperties.label: date last updated
dataProperties.definition: The date on which a particular endeavour, such as an ontology, was last updated.

dataProperties.label: has URL
dataProperties.definition: An identifier, in form of an HTTP Universal Resource Locator (URL), for a particular resource on the World Wide Web.

dataProperties.label: has issue identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier used to identify a specific issue of a magazine, a journal or other resource.

dataProperties.label: has number
dataProperties.definition: A literal (for example a number or a letter) that identifies the sequence position of a work within a particular context, for example a book in a book series, a chapter in a document, a volume in a journal.

dataProperties.label: has handle
dataProperties.definition: A persistent identifier of the Handel system for digital objects and other resources on the Internet.

dataProperties.label: has decision date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which a particular endeavour, such as a grant application, has been or will be approved or rejected by somebody.

dataProperties.label: has standard number
dataProperties.definition: The number defining an international standard, for example Z39.96 - 201x, identifying NISO JATS, the Journal Article Tag Suite.

dataProperties.label: has date collected
dataProperties.definition: The date on which some item has been collected, for example the data gathered by means of questionnaires.

dataProperties.label: has ending page
dataProperties.definition: Identifies the last page of an entity such as a journal article.

dataProperties.label: has page count
dataProperties.definition: The count of the number of pages in a textual resource.

dataProperties.label: has PubMed Central identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier for bibliographic entities hosted by the PubMed Central repository.

dataProperties.label: has publication date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which a resource is published or disclosed.

dataProperties.label: has ISSN
dataProperties.definition: The International Standard Serial Number, ISSN, an identifer for serial publications.

dataProperties.label: has creation date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an entity has been created.

dataProperties.label: has subtitle
dataProperties.definition: A secondary title that follows the main title of a work.

dataProperties.label: has copyright date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which an entity has been copyrighted.

dataProperties.label: has publication year
dataProperties.definition: The year in which a resource is published.

dataProperties.label: has embargo date
dataProperties.definition: The date before which an entity should not be published, or before which a press release should not be reported on.  For open-access journal articles, the embargo date is the date before which availability of the open-access version of the article is restricted by the publisher, following subscription-access availability of the published work.  The duration of the embargo period can be specified by fabio:hasEmbargoDuration.

dataProperties.label: has CODEN
dataProperties.definition: A CODEN is a six character, alphanumeric bibliographic identification code, that provides concise, unique and unambiguous identification of the titles of serials and non-serial publications.

dataProperties.label: alternate title
dataProperties.definition: An alternative title for a resource.

dataProperties.label: has ISBN
dataProperties.definition: The International Standard Book Number, ISBN, used to identify published books or, more rarely, journal issues.

dataProperties.label: has volume identifier
dataProperties.definition: An identifier for a particular volume of a resource, such as a journal or a multi-volume book.

dataProperties.label: has preprint dissemination date
dataProperties.definition: The date on which something is distributed, for example the date on which a preprint of a document is e-mailed to colleagues and other academics by the author(s), or the date on which a printed announcement of forthcoming theatre events is mailed to those those on the theatre's mailing list.

dataProperties.label: has identifier
dataProperties.definition:
A unique and unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

Recommended best practice is to identify the resource by means of a string conforming to a formal identification system.

dataProperties.label: has word count
dataProperties.definition: The count of the number of words in a textual resource.

dataProperties.label: has National Library of Medicine journal identifier
dataProperties.definition: An internal identifier for journals available from the National Library of Medicine repository.

dataProperties.label: has embargo period
dataProperties.definition: The time period for which an entity is embargoed.  During this period, the entity should not be published or, in the case of a press release, should not be reported on.  For open-access journal articles, the embargo duration specifies that period of time during which availability of the open-access version of the article is delayed by the publisher, following subscription-access availability of the published work.  The end of the embargo period can be specified by fabio:hasEmbargoDate.

dataProperties.label: has eISSN
dataProperties.definition: An International Standard Serial Number, ISSN, for electronic versions of serial publications.

dataProperties.label: has keyword
dataProperties.definition: A property used to tag a resource with a keyword that is likely to be used in search queries.

dataProperties.label: has season
dataProperties.definition: Permits specification of the season of the year, for example spring, summer, autumn and winter in British English.

dataProperties.label: has title
dataProperties.definition: A name given to a resource.  Typically, the title will be the name by which the resource is formally known.

dataProperties.label: has National Library of Medicine journal title abbreviation
dataProperties.definition: An internal identifier for the abbreviation of the title of journals available from the National Library of Medicine repository.

dataProperties.label: has page range
dataProperties.definition: Identifies the page range of an entity such as a journal article.

dataProperties.label: has translated subtitle
dataProperties.definition: A version of the subtitle of an entity translated into another language, which may be specified using the object property dcterms:language.

dataProperties.label: has date
dataProperties.definition:
A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

Date may be used to express temporal information at any level of granularity. Recommended best practice is to use an encoding scheme, such as the W3CDTF profile of ISO 8601 [http://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime].

dataProperties.label: has translated title
dataProperties.definition: A version of the title of an entity translated into another language, which may be specified using the object property dcterms:language.

dataProperties.label: has patent number
dataProperties.definition: A unique identifing number issued by a patent authority to identify a patent, displayed at the beginning of the patent document.
